title: Entergy Louisiana President and CEO Phillip May discusses economic growth and energy infrastructure on FUELED podcast
summary: Entergy Louisiana President and CEO Phillip May recently joined Kathryn Fenstermaker for Episode 7 of FUELED to discuss the intersection of economic development and energy infrastructure in Louisiana.
body_markdown:
Entergy Louisiana President and CEO Phillip May recently joined Kathryn Fenstermaker for Episode 7 of FUELED to discuss the intersection of economic development and energy infrastructure in Louisiana.


As the state continues to attract new businesses and industrial investment, access to reliable, affordable power remains essential to supporting economic growth and meeting the evolving needs of customers.


During the conversation, May discusses the important role Entergy Louisiana plays in supporting the state’s economic development efforts and the investments needed to strengthen the electric grid and accommodate growing energy demand.


Entergy Louisiana remains committed to working with state and local partners to support economic development, strengthen grid reliability and deliver long-term value for the customers and communities it serves.


[Watch the full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o-LPqUsSo7U) to learn more about Entergy Louisiana’s role in powering the state’s economic future.
